parts.premise: How do you determine the right amount of homework, given that we are all working for the betterment of the students? Educators can poll students periodically to figure out if they are okay with the workload or are overwhelmed. Educators can see who has struggled the most in a given month in class and then assign less work  so the underperforming student can finish in the allotted/recommended time.  Eliciting students’ thoughts on homework enables teachers to understand how they can better
parts.hypothesis: Guidelines recommend no homework for first grade students and 10 minutes for second grade.
